This isnt a book i promise, long read maybe but gives you a better understanding of why Barlow Med Centre is THE best med centre. Grab a cuppa and have a read.

Without the genuine compassion, care, support, help and understanding of the amazing reception staff and Doc J, I wouldnt be writing this review. The reception staff front and rear have and continue to go above and beyond to help every individual and myself who walks in with the upmost consideration and wont ever fob you off and will do all they can to help.

Doc Jeffery is my GP and without a doubt the best Doc ive ever had. His ability to reasure, help, guide who will go out of his way to get you sorted. Im not being a bum kisser but Doc J is that doctor who cares deeply. His reasuring and handling of all my issues he truly understands. I can honeslty say id be in a grave if it wasnt for his knowledge of what i needed and never once fobbed me of.. he listens, he understands and he wants to help.

I class the Doc and receptionists at Barlow Med Centre as family and can call them anytime. They are there to help.

Thankyou or a box of chocs go along way and its the small things like that which make a huge difference.

If you are looking for a med centre I 100 percent recommend Barlow Med Centre. Id run naked down the high street if you found a better surgery in the local and surrounding areas.

I cant say thankyou to them all as they truly and unknowingly saved my life. Dont suffer in silence, all the staff want to help amd will help.

Ive finished my review now and bet your glad. Hope I didnt bore you. If it did then my name is Charles Dickens!!

This contradicts what is said on the NHS website for this GP practice - it claims that appointments can be made by calling. When we did call on a Friday we were told dispassionately to use the online system on Monday.

I probably felt the worse I have ever felt in my life, like I was going to die .. but as luck would have it I was treated by a Dr Saeed who is one of the nicest doctors I have ever had the pleasure of meeting. I ended up staying at the clinic for a good few hours whilst the doctor ran tests and checks .. nothing was too much trouble. You can tell Dr Saeed was made to be a doctor he just has the perfect manner . I left with a prescription and started my meds the next morning . Today .. just 24 hours later I feel so much better. Flu is serious business .. lol
Today I missed a call on my phone and it was the doctor checking if everything was ok when I checked my voicemail .

10/10 . I’m considering moving from my current practice. I wouldn’t hesistate to recommend . The ladies on reception are lovely too

Thanks to everyone who helped

in common with a lot of the responses, please complain so that we can try to improve our service, its very easy, almost as easy as writing a google review and we take it very seriously.
GP reception is a difficult job, and not well paid. Research suggests that the famous grumpy receptionist is a consequence of the huge emotional range required throughout the day "we just got married", "my dad has died", "i've had a a baby", "thank you so much" and "i'm very angry" being a fairly typical half hour! This can lead to feeling overwhelmed,  emotional flatness and reluctance to engage. Often this is coupled with intransigence from the system and the need to enforce instructions which may appear obstructive.
We try very hard to make our receptionists job less stressful and there should always be an option for them to take rather than getting into conflict. It seems to work a lot of the time if you look at the other reviews here and on NHS choices. Perhaps someone was having a bad day, or perhaps we have a member of staff who needs help or further training.
If you have any problems in future or would like to complain about what upset you this time, that would be very helpful to us, and hopefully more useful to you and our other patients,
Many thanks , Barlow Medical to several other reviewers, as a long time user of the practice I feel compelled to stand up for the telephone callback service which I've had no problems with. Sure, it's not quite as personal as it used to be, but it still guarantees same-day access to medical staff. A further upside is that it avoids overwhelming the waiting room with a heaving mass of potentially infectious patients first thing in the morning (a not uncommon sight prior to the phone service's introduction), instead spreading out the appointments of those that need to be seen over the day.

In several cases, I've even been prescribed medication without needing to be seen at all, which naturally frees up a bit of the staff's time for seeing those that really require an exam or consultation.

Yes, it's fairly obvious the NHS is struggling under the load, but I've been very impressed with Barlow Med's response to the times. The staff have always been professional and polite, in my experience, and the practice is clean and accessible. The adjacent pharmacy is convenient and, although the recent switch to electronic prescriptions seems to be causing some headaches, a pharmacist friend assures me that's a common complaint - not specific to this pharmacy. Hopefully, training will smooth out the issues there in the coming year.

Overall, when I compare my experience at Barlow Med to friends and family who are registered at other practices in the area, I'm very happy with the
